changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql:
DO $$ DECLARE constraint_name text; BEGIN SELECT con.conname INTO constraint_name FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class rel ON rel.oid = con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace nsp ON nsp.oid = rel.relnamespace JOIN unnest(con.conkey) AS colnum(attnum) ON TRUE JOIN pg_attribute attr ON attr.attrelid = rel.oid AND attr.attnum = colnum.attnum WHERE nsp.nspname = 'app' AND rel.relname = 'authors' AND con.contype = 'u' AND attr.attname = 'user_id' LIMIT 1;
IF constraint_name IS NOT NULL THEN EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE app.authors DROP CONSTRAINT %I', constraint_name); END IF; END $$;
